lastCompletedStory.title: Build the on-demand in-container test harness

nextStoryContext: US-001 shipped. scripts/test-in-container.ts is the on-demand harness: injectable ensureFn/execFn seams, parseBunOutput parser with Set-dedup for per-file+failure-block double-print, exit code re-derived from parsed fail count (not raw docker exec exit). test:container alias in package.json. ADR 0003 updated with operator runbook pointer. NOT in GATES manifest or ci.yml.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: summary lines are ' N pass' / ' N fail' / ' N skip' (single leading space). CLAUDECODE=1 hides passing/skip detail but keeps summary + failure detail. Format matches parser implementation.
